goal: Allow Bitcoin Core users to send bitcoin directly to BIP 352 Silent Payment addresses
Enables transacting with recipients relying on Silent Payments for privacy without third-party wallets
agreement: Concept approval without stated reasons (rkrux, w0xlt, rustaceanrob)
Unaddressed objection: MSVC compilation failure in walletmodel.cpp, no author reply (Yudis-bit)
Objection: silent payments non-replaceability on older software confuses UI on fee bumping (rustaceanrob)
Author answered objections on Taproot input eligibility and RBF recipient metadata persistence (Yudis-bit)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it updates raw transaction RPC utilities to handle silent payment destinations
Adds a diagnostic RPC method for scanning silent payments without broader RPC architecture impact

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it adds wallet support for sending to BIP 352 addresses directly
Solves a major privacy barrier by letting users avoid address reuse when paying silent payment recipients
